newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria court rules Agricredit bank insolvent.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria court rules Agricredit bank insolvent.

text.p: The Sofia City Court declared the Bank for Agricultural Credit (BAC) insolvent at the request of the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB), a BNB official said on Monday.
The BAC is the seventh Bulgarian commercial bank declared insolvent by courts out of seventeen local, state and private banks against which the BNB has opened bankruptcy procedures since May 1996.
They include state-owned Mineralbank, private Krystalbank, Private Agricultural and Investment bank, Trade and Savings Bank (TSB), Slavyani Bank and Agrobusinessbank.
The BNB has withdrawn insolvency claims against two of the seventeen banks after they were brought - Mollovbank, later re-named Eurobank, and Yambol Bank.
In March 1996 the BNB acquired some 52 percent of BAC in a bid to protect depositors' savings and filed an insolvency suit against it in January.
The Bank Consolidation Company (BCC), which manages state equity in local commercial banks holds 25.1 percent of the BAC voting shares.@ -- Roumiana Tikholova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-91188
